title: Assessment by the Department of Public Utilities in accordance with the provisions of M.G.L. c. 25, §§ 17A and 18 and c. 111, § 5K, against Boston Edison Company and New England Power Service Company to cover costs incurred by the Department of Public Health for monitoring, surveying and inspecting the Pilgrim and Yankee Rowe nuclear power plants during fiscal years 1995 and 1996.
